Its only durable delta was an in-place re-stamp of three files in the 44674389464 namespace (fresh generated_at_utc 2026-11-20T05:24:04Z; write_scope snapshot collapsed from 15 entries to 1). It produced no state block, no claim-bearing result record, no report and no freeze/hypothesis for its own run id. The current checkout therefore had no auditable producer deliverable for 44680596390. This is the standing zero-substantive-delta / re-derivation pathology (ordered item 5), not a measurement failure, not rc=67 zero-delta from the retry wrapper, not a frozen-bar result and not a product defect. Job logs require repository admin rights (HTTP 403), so the precise workflow step that rejected it is not asserted from a log line.
